approved_decision.rule: Keep VANI as WATCH with unresolved semantics. Require targeted historical recovery/archaeology before any semantic assignment. If no historical meaning is recovered and a concrete need remains, a separate explicit semantic-authorship gate may later propose a meaning with historicalRecoveryClaim=false.
approved_decision.rationale: B7 governs -VAN only as NONPRODUCTIVE_CLOSED_EVIDENCE and B9 governs final -I only as a nonmorphemic distributional tendency. Combining them does not justify VANI=live/reside as recovered semantics.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not assign morar/residir, live/reside, residence or habitation semantics to VANI under B12.
Do not recognize VAN+I as a productive or nonproductive derivational analysis of VANI from this gate.
Preserve VANI authority WATCH and gloss UNRECOVERED until direct recovery or a separate explicit authorship decision.
If future authorship is considered, it must state historicalRecoveryClaim=false and must not retroactively reinterpret B7 or B9 as productive morphology.
B12 changes no individual lexical semantics, morphology productivity, grammar, authority levels, or curriculum slots.
